## `client.sign_in`

Sign-in links a program asks for: `Client.sign_in`.

### `client.sign_in.setup_link`

Signature: `client.sign_in.setup_link() -> IssuedLink`

Issue the setup link that signs the first administrator in to the web interface.

Only the server operator's bootstrap token may ask, and only while the first administrator has no passkey. The link works once, for 10 minutes; earlier open setup links are withdrawn.

Returns: `IssuedLink`. The link, shown only here.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If the token is not the operator's bootstrap token. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the first administrator has a passkey already (use a recovery link), or the interface is off. |

### `client.sign_in.local_link`

Signature: `client.sign_in.local_link() -> IssuedLink`

Issue a sign-in link for yourself, with your own personal access token.

Only on a server with local sign-in on (`lakana server start --local` sets it). The link works once, for 60 seconds, and signs in without a passkey touch.

Returns: `IssuedLink`. The link, shown only here.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If local sign-in is off on the server. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If the credential is not a person's own personal access token. |

### `client.sign_in.oidc_info`

Signature: `client.sign_in.oidc_info() -> OidcInfo`

Say whether the server signs people in through an identity provider.

Sends no credential.

Returns: `OidcInfo`. Whether it is on, and the provider's name.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | From a server older than sign-in through a provider. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the server's web interface is off. |

### `client.sign_in.exchange_code`

Signature: `client.sign_in.exchange_code(code: str, code_verifier: str) -> IssuedToken`

Exchange the one-time code of a sign-in confirmed in a browser for a new token.

Sends no credential: the code and the PKCE verifier it was confirmed for are the proof. The code works once, for 2 minutes; a wrong verifier uses it up too.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `str` | required | The code the browser brought back to the command line. |
| `code_verifier` | `str` | required | The PKCE verifier whose S256 challenge the browser confirmed. |

Returns: `IssuedToken`. The confirming person's new token, named ``lakana login on &lt;host&gt;``, for 90 days.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.LakanaError` | With status 400 for an unknown, used, expired or wrong code or verifier; the message says to sign in again. |

### `client.sign_in.start_device`

Signature: `client.sign_in.start_device(host: str) -> DeviceSignIn`

Start a sign-in of the command line to confirm in a browser elsewhere.

Sends no credential. Show `DeviceSignIn.user_code` and `DeviceSignIn.verification_url` to the person, then call `poll_device` every `DeviceSignIn.interval` seconds.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | `str` | required | This computer's name, for the confirmation and the token's name. |

Returns: `DeviceSignIn`. The codes, the page and the interval.

### `client.sign_in.poll_device`

Signature: `client.sign_in.poll_device(device_code: str) -> DeviceSignInPoll`

Ask whether a device sign-in was confirmed; an approved one answers its token once.

Sends no credential.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device_code` | `str` | required | `DeviceSignIn.device_code`. |

Returns: `DeviceSignInPoll`. The state, with the token once approved; ``slow_down`` for any 429: asked too soon, or past the server's rate.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.LakanaError` | With status 400 for a device code the server does not know. |

## `client.invites`

Invites of new people: `Client.invites`. Needs the ADMIN role.

### `client.invites.create`

Signature: `client.invites.create(name: str, display_name: str | None = None) -> Invite`

Invite a new person by a link that creates their account when used.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The new person's principal name; refused when any principal or open invite has it in any letter case. |
| `display_name` | `str | None` | `None` | The person's name as the interface shows it; optional. |

Returns: `Invite`. The invite and its link, shown only here: it works once, for 7 days, and creates an account with no rights. Confirm who signed up before granting roles.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the name is taken in any letter case. |

### `client.invites.list`

Signature: `client.invites.list() -> list[OpenInvite]`

List the open invites, oldest first, without their links.

Returns: `list of OpenInvite`. Invites neither used, withdrawn nor expired.

### `client.invites.withdraw`

Signature: `client.invites.withdraw(invite_id: str) -> None`

Withdraw an open invite: its link stops working and its name is free again.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invite_id` | `str` | required | The invite's id, from `create` or `list`. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no invite has this id. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If it was used or withdrawn already. |

## `client.recovery_links`

Recovery links for people who lost their passkeys: `Client.recovery_links`.

### `client.recovery_links.create`

Signature: `client.recovery_links.create(principal: str) -> RecoveryLink`

Issue a recovery link for a person who lost their passkeys.

Using it removes their passkeys, ends their sessions and tells them and every administrator. Needs the ADMIN role. Recovering anyone who holds or has ever held the ADMIN role, directly or through a group, needs the server operator's bootstrap token (the profile `lakana bundle init` or `lakana server start --local` saved). A new link withdraws the person's previous open one.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The person's principal name. |

Returns: `RecoveryLink`. The link, shown only here: it works once, for 1 hour.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | For an administrator, unless the token is the operator's bootstrap token. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | For yourself, a service account or a deactivated account. |

### `client.recovery_links.list`

Signature: `client.recovery_links.list() -> list[OpenRecoveryLink]`

List the open recovery links, oldest first, without the links themselves.

Returns: `list of OpenRecoveryLink`. Links neither used, withdrawn nor expired.

### `client.recovery_links.withdraw`

Signature: `client.recovery_links.withdraw(link_id: str) -> None`

Withdraw an open recovery link; it stops working at once.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link_id` | `str` | required | The link's id, from `create` or `list`. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no recovery link has this id. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If it was used or withdrawn already. |

## `client.sessions`

A person's browser sessions: `Client.sessions`.

### `client.sessions.list`

Signature: `client.sessions.list(principal: str) -> list[BrowserSession]`

List a person's open browser sessions, oldest first.

Your own, or anyone's with the ADMIN role.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The person's principal name. |

Returns: `list of BrowserSession`. The open sessions.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | For another person's sessions without the ADMIN role. |

### `client.sessions.end_all`

Signature: `client.sessions.end_all(principal: str) -> None`

End every browser session of a person; each is recorded in the audit log.

Your own (sign out everywhere), or anyone's with the ADMIN role.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The person's principal name. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | For another person's sessions without the ADMIN role. |

## `client.passkeys`

A person's passkeys: `Client.passkeys`. Adding one happens in the web interface.

### `client.passkeys.list`

Signature: `client.passkeys.list(principal: str) -> list[Passkey]`

List a person's passkeys, oldest first.

Your own, or anyone's with the ADMIN role.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The person's principal name. |

Returns: `list of Passkey`. The passkeys, disabled ones included.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | For another person's passkeys without the ADMIN role. |

### `client.passkeys.remove`

Signature: `client.passkeys.remove(principal: str, passkey_id: str) -> None`

Remove a passkey.

Your own, or anyone's with the ADMIN role; removing another person's also ends their browser sessions. Your own last working passkey cannot be removed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | `str` | required | The person's principal name. |
| `passkey_id` | `str` | required | The passkey's id, from `list`. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.Conflict` | If it is your own last working passkey (add another first). |

## `client.sign_in_settings`

How long browser sessions last: `Client.sign_in_settings`.

### `client.sign_in_settings.get`

Signature: `client.sign_in_settings.get() -> SignInSettings`

Read the session lengths, in minutes, with the bounds they may be set between.

Returns: `SignInSettings`. The lengths in force for new sessions.

### `client.sign_in_settings.update`

Signature: `client.sign_in_settings.update(idle_timeout_minutes: int | None = None, absolute_lifetime_minutes: int | None = None, token_provider_window_days: int | None = None) -> SignInSettings`

Change how long new browser sessions last, or the token window of linked people.

Open sessions keep their lengths; a new token window applies to the next request with a token. Needs the ADMIN role. Recorded in the audit log.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idle_timeout_minutes` | `int | None` | `None` | The idle timeout, 15 to 1440 minutes (24 hours); `None` keeps it. |
| `absolute_lifetime_minutes` | `int | None` | `None` | The absolute lifetime, 60 to 43200 minutes (30 days), not shorter than the idle timeout; `None` keeps it. |
| `token_provider_window_days` | `int | None` | `None` | How long a person linked to the identity provider may use their personal tokens after their last sign-in there, 1 to 365 days; `None` keeps it. |

Returns: `SignInSettings`. The lengths now in force for new sessions.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If a value is outside its bounds; the message names the bound. |
